notes.title: 3.0 Update!
notes.content:
update summary

List of changes:


 Removed photo mode

 Improved post processing

 added a new "aesthetic mode"

 minor bugs fixed

 Pause fixed

 Motion blur removed

 annoying puzzle in chapter 3 removed

 weird camera fixed

 Sky screens in chapter 3 is actually screens now

 new achievements added


More detailed information about the changes:

PHOTO MODE

Photo mode was removed due to serious errors it was occuring.

NEW MODE

Aesthetic mode, is mode just for chill. No puzzles, no enemy. Just you and some collectibles.

That's all the big changes!

A new game called "Inner Darkness" Is in active development now! Stay tuned.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678060/Inner_Darkness/

notes.title: 2.1 Update!
notes.content:
Fixed:

Pause widget has been fixed.

Old screensavers and videos.

 "Dynamic" background of the main menu.

That's all! hope you enjoy this update)

notes.title: 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769237/949c3eeaab90fcf026d20eab0566056b5894d3bb.png

update summary

List of changes:


 added photo mode

 improved enemy

 added a new location replacing chapter 3

 minor bugs fixed

 changed the music in the last location of chapter 1

 new achievements added


More detailed information about the changes:

PHOTO MODE

Photo mode is now available in the game! How to use it? just press the P key to activate it, and to view the gallery you need to press the G key.
It has a wide enough functionality to create high-quality screenshots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769237/62a238ee581a6a5fdba50e1da9b1bb45e670b31d.png

NEW LOCATION

Due to the boredom and monotony of the last and in fact climactic location, it was completely replaced with a new one. The new location has a completely different atmosphere and has no notes.

ENEMY

The shadow has become more aggressive and frightening


That's all the big changes!

A new part called Project Liminal 2 will be released in the future.

Do you want to follow the news and the development of new projects? Then you can subscribe to our YouTube channel
